info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Cloud Cost Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Registers a cloud account (a name, the provider and its account id, one currency, a monthly budget, the warning use, the reporting interval, an optional vendor), reads and lists it with filters, reports what days cost (the same day and amount again is 200 with the stored report; another amount is a correction; going back to an earlier amount counts again), watches the current month go OK, NEAR_BUDGET (from the straight line to the month end) and OVER_BUDGET, sees a late cost of last month kept out of this month, lists by level, lists and reads the reports, updates the budget, pauses and resumes it (a paused account is not judged), accepts a cost for tomorrow (the provider day may be ahead), and reads the audit ledger in order. A second folder proves the service is staff only (403 ERR-CLD-00403 for a REQUESTER on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (blank or long name, unknown provider or currency, a bad provider account id, budgets and amounts negative, with three decimals or too large, warning and interval out of range, a malformed vendor id, missing executor or tenant, missing fields, a day two days ahead, a day that cannot be read), duplicates (409), illegal transitions, tenant isolation, unknown filters, list limits and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (ccOrganisationId).
